evals.prompt: Use the setup skill. I run the Trigger.dev init from a CI job with no terminal against our self-hosted server at https://trigger.example.com. Which command do I run?
evals.expected_output: Should give npx trigger.dev@latest init --yes --project-ref proj_xxx -a <url> --no-browser
expectations: The answer runs npx trigger.dev@latest init
The answer passes --yes to skip the prompts
The answer passes --project-ref with a proj_ value because --yes needs it
The answer passes -a with the self-hosted URL
